title: Your 2027, Month by Month

intake.question: What do you want 2027 to be about?

plan.title: February and March: the year wakes up
April and May: growth and heat
Your elements in a Fire year
June and July: the Fire peak
December and January: the year closes

strong.text: With a strong chart, you have the energy to use this year fully. The risk is overcommitting in the first months and arriving at autumn exhausted. Map the year: pick two months for big pushes, two for rest, and let the rest be ordinary. Strong charts thrive with a rhythm, not a constant sprint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Map it: two push months, two rest months. The rest, ordinary.

weak.text: With a weak chart, this year's energy will feel stronger in some months than others. Use the supportive ones. You don't need to keep pace with louder people; you need to pick your moments. A well-timed effort in a good month beats a year of forcing.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pick your moments. Timing beats forcing.

strong.text: With a strong chart, your plan works best with fewer goals, chosen carefully. You'll be tempted to add more as the year goes on. Keep a 'not this year' list and put new ideas there; you can revisit it in 2028.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: New idea mid-year? 'Not this year' list. Revisit in 2028.

weak.text: With a weak chart, your plan works best with kindness built in: small goals, real rest, and people who support you. Write down one thing you'll protect no matter how busy the year gets. That's the plan's backbone.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Name your non-negotiable for the year. Guard it.

peer_strong.text: Your chart is heavy on {dm_el}, your own element. In a year plan that means independence and self-direction: you set your own course and resist being steered. Months that bring your own element will feel like too much of a good thing; months that bring your output or wealth elements will feel productive. Use the busy, social months to collaborate instead of compete.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Heavy on your own element. Collaborate in the crowded months.

output_strong.text: Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} produces: expression and creativity. In a year plan, you'll want to create, speak and share constantly. That's wonderful in months that support it and draining in months that already pull your energy outward. Track your energy and save big creative pushes for the months that refill you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy on {heavy_el}. Save big creative pushes for months that refill you.

wealth_strong.text: Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} controls: goals and results. In a year plan, you'll focus on achievements and may treat every month as a deadline. Let some months be about people and rest; results come easier after them.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Goals all year? Give a few months to friends instead.

power_strong.text: Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element that shapes your {dm_el}: responsibility and standards. In a year plan, you'll take on duties and keep them. Watch for months that add more pressure on top; say no to new obligations then.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy on {heavy_el}: dutiful. Decline extra duties in pressure months.

resource_strong.text: Your chart is heavy on {heavy_el}, the element that feeds your {dm_el}: learning and reflection. In a year plan, you'll gravitate toward study and inner work. Make sure some months include action; reflection is most useful when it leads somewhere.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Heavy on {heavy_el}: reflective. Schedule action months too.

output_weak.text: Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} produces: giving and expressing. In a year plan, guard your energy in months that pull you outward even more. Choose fewer projects and finish them, rather than starting many.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fewer projects, finished. Guard energy in outward months.

wealth_weak.text: Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element your {dm_el} controls, wealth heavy and self light. In a year plan, you may take on more than you can carry. Use supportive months to ask for help and share responsibilities.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Lots to carry. Ask for help in the supportive months.

power_weak.text: Your chart leans on {heavy_el}, the element that presses on your {dm_el}. In a year plan, pressure months will feel heavier for you. Lower expectations then, and protect the things that steady you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Lower the bar in pressure months. Protect what steadies you.

rooted_on_paper.text: In a year plan, that means you may feel confident in some months and unexpectedly shaky in others. Both are normal for your chart. Notice which months bring support and lean into them; treat the others as months for care, not proof.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Confident some months, shaky others. Normal for your chart.

output_strong.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the output element, expression. Months whose stems or branches bring {miss_el} will feel unusually creative and talkative for you. Use them to share work and speak up.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Months with {miss_el} make you talkative. Use them to share.

wealth_strong.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the wealth element, pursuit. Months that bring {miss_el} will nudge you toward goals and opportunities. Say yes to the right ones.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Months with {miss_el} bring opportunities. Choose well.

power_strong.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the power element, structure. Months that bring {miss_el} may bring responsibility or rules. Treat them as chances to build good habits.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Months with {miss_el} bring structure. Build habits then.

resource_strong.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the resource element, support and learning. Months that bring {miss_el} are good for study, mentors and rest. Use them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Months with {miss_el}: study and rest. Take them.

output_weak.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the output element. Months with {miss_el} will invite you to express yourself. Do it in small, sustainable ways.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Express yourself in small ways when {miss_el} months come.

wealth_weak.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the wealth element. Months with {miss_el} bring opportunities; take one, not five.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Take one opportunity in {miss_el} months. Not five.

power_weak.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the power element. Months with {miss_el} may feel demanding. Keep your schedule lighter then.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Keep the schedule light when {miss_el} months arrive.

resource_weak.text: {miss_el} is missing from your visible chart, and for your {dm_el} it's the resource element, support. Months with {miss_el} are your refills. Plan rest and time with supportive people into them.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: {miss_el} months are your refills. Plan rest into them.

none_strong.text: All five elements turn up in your pillars, so every month meets something familiar in your chart. Your year will feel balanced overall. Choose your priorities clearly so the balance doesn't turn into drift.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: All five elements present. Pick priorities so you don't drift.

none_weak.text: All five elements turn up in your pillars, so you can adapt to each month's mood. Use that flexibility, and keep a few fixed anchors in the year so you don't spend it adapting to everyone else.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Adaptable all year. Keep a few fixed anchors.

resource.title: What steadies you in 2027: {helper_el}
resource.text: Every chart has an element that brings it back to balance. For your weak {dm_el} chart it's {helper_el}, the element that feeds your Day Master. In 2027, months that bring {helper_el} are your easier months; in the others, bring {helper_el} in through habits: people, places and routines that refill you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your steadying element in 2027: {helper_el}.

peer.title: What steadies you in 2027: {helper_el}, your own element
peer.text: Every chart has an element that brings it back to balance. Yours already carries plenty of nourishment on paper, so what steadies you is your own element, {helper_el}: friends, peers and people on your wavelength. Plan time with them across the year.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your steadying element: {helper_el}. Friends across the year.

output.title: What balances you in 2027: {helper_el}
output.text: Every chart has an element that brings it back to balance. A strong {dm_el} chart needs an outlet, and yours is {helper_el}, the element your Day Master produces. In 2027, put energy into creating and sharing. Months that bring {helper_el} are good for launches.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Your outlet in 2027: {helper_el}. Launch in those months.

wealth.title: What balances you in 2027: {helper_el}
wealth.text: Every chart has an element that brings it back to balance. Yours is strong and expressive, so what balances you is {helper_el}, the element your Day Master shapes. In 2027, aim your energy at concrete goals. Months that bring {helper_el} are good for finishing things.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Your balance in 2027: {helper_el}. Finish things in those months.

wood.text: Wood habits for 2027: morning walks, learning something new, plants, and planning ahead each season.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Wood for 2027: walks, plants, a seasonal plan.

fire.text: Fire habits for 2027: sunlight, warm gatherings, celebrating small wins, moving your body to music.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fire for 2027: sunlight and small celebrations.

earth.text: Earth habits for 2027: steady routines, home cooking, a tidy home base, regular sleep.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Earth for 2027: routines, home cooking, steady sleep.

metal.text: Metal habits for 2027: decluttering each season, clear priorities, finishing tasks, saying no.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Metal for 2027: declutter each season. Say no.

water.text: Water habits for 2027: quiet evenings, journaling, swims or baths, time to think without input.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Water for 2027: quiet evenings and journaling.

rat.text: Your day branch, the Rat 子, and the year's Goat 未 form what classical texts call a harm pair (害): small misunderstandings, crossed wires at home or with close people. Nothing dramatic. Over-communicate in 2027, especially with partners and roommates.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rat meets Goat: crossed wires. Over-communicate this year.

ox.text: Your day branch, the Ox 丑, clashes with the year's Goat 未 (丑未沖), opposite animals. Clash years bring movement in personal life: moves, changes at home, shifts in close relationships. Plan for flexibility and keep your routines steady where you can.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Ox meets Goat: a clash year. Expect movement at home.

tiger.text: Your day branch, the Tiger 寅, sits neutrally with the year's Goat 未. Your personal life won't be shaken by the year itself; what you build there is up to you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Tiger and Goat: neutral. Your home life is yours to shape.

rabbit.text: Your day branch, the Rabbit 卯, joins the year's Goat 未 in the Wood trio (亥卯未). It's a supportive link for personal life: easier connection, warmer friendships, a sense that people are on your side.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rabbit and Goat: Wood trio. Warm year for close bonds.

dragon.text: Your day branch, the Dragon 辰, sits neutrally with the year's Goat 未, two Earth branches side by side. Steady ground at home; good for practical projects.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Dragon and Goat: steady ground. Good for home projects.

snake.text: Your day branch, the Snake 巳, sits neutrally with the year's Goat 未, and both lean warm. Expect a lively, social personal life with plenty of energy.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Snake and Goat: warm and social. Pace yourself.

horse.text: Your day branch, the Horse 午, forms a six-harmony pair with the year's Goat 未 (午未合). It's one of the nicest links a year can make with your personal life: closeness, ease, and support from people near you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Horse and Goat: six-harmony. A close, easy year at home.

goat.text: Your day branch is the Goat 未, the same as the year's. Saju calls a branch meeting itself a self-punishment pair (自刑) when it repeats: the year mirrors you, strengths and habits alike. Expect to notice your own patterns clearly. Use the clarity kindly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Goat meets Goat: a mirror year. Be kind to what you see.

monkey.text: Your day branch, the Monkey 申, sits neutrally with the year's Goat 未. Earth feeds Metal here, so the year quietly supports your personal plans.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Monkey and Goat: quiet support for your plans.

rooster.text: Your day branch, the Rooster 酉, sits neutrally with the year's Goat 未, with Earth gently feeding your branch's Metal. A calm year at home.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Rooster and Goat: a calm year at home.

dog.text: Your day branch, the Dog 戌, and the year's Goat 未 are part of the classic Earth punishment group (丑戌未). Expect some friction with close people over responsibilities. Clear agreements help.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Dog and Goat: friction over who does what. Agree early.

pig.text: Your day branch, the Pig 亥, joins the year's Goat 未 in the Wood trio (亥卯未). A supportive link: generous friends, easy cooperation, warm personal life.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pig and Goat: Wood trio. Generous, cooperative year.

day_branch_heading: The Goat meets your day branch, the {day_animal} ({day_branch})

love.text: You want 2027 to be about love and people. Look at the months marked social or harmonious for you, the ones with your Wealth, Officer or combining branches, and plan your important conversations and gatherings there. In quieter months, deepen the bonds you have instead of seeking new ones.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Plan your big people moments in your harmonious months.

work.text: You want 2027 to be about work and building something. Use your Officer and Wealth months for commitments and results, your output months for creative pushes, and your Resource months for learning. A building year is a rhythm, not a sprint.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Officer months to commit, output months to create, Resource months to learn.

self.text: You want 2027 to be about yourself: habits, calm, growth. Your Resource and Friend months are your best windows for new routines. Start small in February, check in at the Fire peak in July, and review in December.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Small habits from Ipchun. A mid-year check. A December review.

fresh.text: You want a fresh start. Saju agrees that new years begin at Ipchun, so February 4 is your symbolic restart. Use the clearing months, October and November, to let go of what's finished, and February to begin.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Ipchun is your restart button. February 4.

unsaid.text: You didn't pick a focus, so here's a gentle default: choose one thing for the first half of the year and one for the second, and let the months guide the pace.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: One focus per half-year. Let the months set the pace.

great.text: 2026 felt great. Carry its best habits forward, and don't measure 2027 against it month by month. Different years have different jobs.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Great 2026? Keep its habits, not the comparison.

heavy.text: 2026 felt heavy. The Fire Goat year can be gentler if you let it: use the supportive months to rest and rebuild before you push. You don't owe anyone a comeback by spring.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Heavy 2026? No comeback deadline. Rebuild first.

messy.text: 2026 was messy, a bit of everything. 2027 rewards simplifying: fewer commitments, clearer priorities. The Metal months in late summer are ideal for sorting what stays.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Messy 2026? Simplify. Sort what stays in late summer.

quiet.text: 2026 was quiet. A Fire year brings more energy and visibility for most charts. Pick one thing to be braver about, and try it in one of your smoother months.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Quiet 2026? Be braver about one thing this year.

unsaid.text: You didn't say how 2026 felt. Take a minute to name it for yourself. Knowing where you're starting makes the month-by-month plan more useful.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Name how 2026 felt, even just to yourself.

yang.heading: Your year rhythm: yang
yang.text: Your Day Master is yang, the outward half of saju's pair. You'll tend to push in visible bursts through 2027. Plan your bursts for supportive months and follow each one with a quieter stretch.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Yang rhythm: burst, then rest. Plan both.

yin.heading: Your year rhythm: yin
yin.text: Your Day Master is yin, the inward half of saju's pair. You'll make steady, quiet progress through 2027. Don't compare yourself to louder people; your consistency adds up by December.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Yin rhythm: quiet progress. It adds up by December.

wood.heading: One habit for the whole year
wood.text: Your balancing element is Wood, so your one habit for 2027 is growth: learn one small thing each month, from a recipe to a skill. Twelve months, twelve new things.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Wood habit: one new thing a month. Twelve by December.

fire.heading: One habit for the whole year
fire.text: Your balancing element is Fire, so your one habit for 2027 is warmth: one gathering or celebration a month, even a small one.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Fire habit: one small celebration every month.

earth.heading: One habit for the whole year
earth.text: Your balancing element is Earth, so your one habit for 2027 is routine: a fixed weekly anchor, a Sunday reset, a regular meal with someone.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Earth habit: one weekly anchor you never skip.

metal.heading: One habit for the whole year
metal.text: Your balancing element is Metal, so your one habit for 2027 is clearing: once a month, remove one thing, object, commitment or habit, that you don't need.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Metal habit: remove one thing every month.

water.heading: One habit for the whole year
water.text: Your balancing element is Water, so your one habit for 2027 is reflection: ten minutes of journaling at the start of each saju month.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Water habit: journal at the start of each month.

gap-wood.text:
Here's how a Hurting Officer year tends to look in ordinary life. At work, you're the one who finally says the meeting is pointless, or rewrites the process nobody dared touch. With friends, you're funnier and sharper than usual, and one or two people might find you a bit much. In love, you want to be admired for what you make, not just liked for who you are.

The Direct Wealth underneath asks for follow-through. A good test for any idea this year: can you show something concrete for it within six weeks? If yes, chase it. If it stays a strong opinion, park it. Gap Wood ends 2027 well when the voice and the hands move together.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Can you show something concrete in six weeks? Then chase it.

gap-wood.heading: What the year looks like day to day

eul-wood.text:
An Eating God year is the gentlest kind of output, and for Eul Wood it shows up as pleasure in making things. Cooking, writing, styling, decorating, learning a dance from a video at midnight. You'll want your days to taste good. Friends may notice you're more relaxed and more playful than last year.

The Indirect Wealth in the Goat adds a wandering eye for opportunity: side projects, a spontaneous trip, an offer that comes out of nowhere. Say yes to the ones that sound fun and cost little. The vine in 2027 grows by trying many small walls, not by committing to one huge one. Keep a list of what you tried. By autumn it'll show you where to climb next.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Try lots of small things. Write each one down.

eul-wood.heading: What the year looks like day to day

byeong-fire.text:
A Rob Wealth year on the stem means you'll meet a lot of fellow suns: competitors, collaborators, friends with big plans of their own. For Byeong Fire that looks like group projects, rivalries at work and new people who want a share of your spotlight. Some will push you to be better. Some will simply take credit.

The Goat's Earth is your Hurting Officer, so you'll also want to speak up about all of it. Choose which fires to share the sky with. Partner with the ones who return energy, and keep your best ideas documented with your name on them. Being generous is your nature. Being generous with a paper trail is your 2027 upgrade.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Share the spotlight with people who give energy back. Keep receipts.

byeong-fire.heading: What the year looks like day to day

jeong-fire.text:
A Friend year for Jeong Fire means the year's energy looks a lot like you: warm, focused, quietly intense. That's comforting and a little crowded. Expect more people who think like you, more invitations into small circles, more one-on-one friendships that suddenly go deep.

The Eating God in the Goat gives you an easy outlet. Make things, host things, cook for people. Your creativity is relaxed this year rather than pressured. The watch-out is spreading your flame across too many candles. Pick two or three relationships to invest in properly instead of attending everything. A candle lights a room best from one spot.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Pick two or three people to go deep with. Not everyone.

jeong-fire.heading: What the year looks like day to day

mu-earth.text:
A Direct Resource year brings Mu Earth support, teaching and recognition. In daily life it might be a mentor who takes an interest, a course you finally sign up for, a manager who backs you in a meeting without being asked. The mountain gets warmed by the sun for once.

The Goat's Earth, though, is your Rob Wealth: other mountains nearby, sharing resources and attention. Siblings, colleagues or friends may need you, or compete with you, more than usual. Accept the support coming in and be clear about what you give out. A short rule helps: help when asked, offer once, then let people carry their own load.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Take the mentor's help. Put a limit on everyone else's requests.

mu-earth.heading: What the year looks like day to day

gi-earth.text:
An Indirect Resource year turns Gi Earth inward and curious. You'll want unusual knowledge: astrology, a niche craft, a language nobody around you speaks. Your intuition gets louder too. It's a good year for study and a slightly odd one for small talk.

The Goat's main stem is your own, a Friend, so you'll also find your people: others who tend gardens the way you do. Join a group, a class, a club built around the curious thing. Gi Earth often spends years feeding others; in 2027 you get fed by ideas and by peers who get it. Let both in without turning them into another responsibility.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Find your curious people. Let them feed you for once.

gi-earth.heading: What the year looks like day to day

gyeong-metal.text:
A Direct Officer year asks Gyeong Metal to play by the rules, and to be seen doing it well. At work that might mean a formal role, an exam, a title with accountability attached. In life, commitments get more official: a lease, a contract, a promise made in front of family.

The Goat's Earth is your Direct Resource, so the year also supplies backing for the pressure. Someone senior is likely to vouch for you if you've earned it. Use the structure instead of fighting it. Swords sharpen against stone. In 2027, the stone is a set of expectations you can meet with your eyes open, and the reward is respect that lasts past the year.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Swords sharpen against stone. This year's stone is expectations.

gyeong-metal.heading: What the year looks like day to day

sin-metal.text:
A Seven Killings year is intense for Sin Metal: tight deadlines, demanding people, situations that test your nerve. In daily life it can feel like being polished on a fast wheel. You'll handle more than you think, and you'll want to complain about it more than usual. Both are fine.

The Goat's Earth is your Indirect Resource, an unusual source of protection: an unexpected ally, a strange book that helps, a quiet hobby that keeps you sane. Look for help in odd places this year. And pace your yeses. When pressure is high, every extra favor costs double. The jewel shines brightest after the pressure, not during it.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Unexpected allies this year. Don't say yes to everything.

sin-metal.heading: What the year looks like day to day

im-water.text:
A Direct Wealth year gives Im Water a practical streak. Budgets, plans, a home project, a role with clear deliverables. Things you usually find boring become strangely satisfying. People may be surprised to see the ocean making spreadsheets.

The Goat's Earth is your Direct Officer: responsibilities and structure that hold the water in banks. A promotion track, a formal commitment, a schedule that actually works. Lean into it. 2027 is a year where boring tools serve big dreams. Give your adventures a calendar, and you'll find more of them happen instead of staying ideas for next year.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Give your adventures a calendar. More of them will happen.

im-water.heading: What the year looks like day to day

gye-water.text:
An Indirect Wealth year makes Gye Water more opportunistic in the best sense: noticing openings, saying yes to chance meetings, following a hunch about a side project. You'll be more social than usual and more willing to try things you'd normally overthink.

The Goat's Earth is your Seven Killings, so some of that adventure comes with pressure: a demanding person, a sharp deadline, a challenge that makes you braver. Rain under a hot sky can turn to steam fast. Keep a few quiet anchors through the year, the same morning ritual, one friend you see every week, so the excitement has somewhere calm to land.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Keep a few quiet anchors. Excitement needs somewhere calm to land.

gye-water.heading: What the year looks like day to day

wood.heading: The Goat's hidden Wood, 乙
wood.text: Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, a little 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood, the remnant of spring stored in a summer branch. For a Wood Day Master that sliver is your own element. It works like a friend in the crowd: peers, siblings, teammates who quietly back you through a year that otherwise asks you to give a lot. Notice who those people are by spring. You'll need them in the hot months.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: A sliver of your own Wood hides in the Goat. Find your allies early.

fire.heading: The Goat's hidden Wood, 乙
fire.text: Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, a little 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood. For a Fire Day Master that hidden Wood is fuel, your resource element. It shows up as small, quiet support: a book at the right moment, an older friend's advice, a teacher who sees something in you. It won't arrive loudly. Keep a note of who helped you this year and thank them in December.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hidden Wood feeds your Fire. Small help, quietly delivered.

earth.heading: The Goat's hidden Wood, 乙
earth.text: Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, a little 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood. For an Earth Day Master that hidden Wood is your power element: a gentle form of discipline and expectation. It's the deadline you set yourself, the standard someone you admire holds you to. Mild pressure, the kind that roots a field rather than cracking it. Accept one structured commitment this year and see what grows.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: The hidden Wood is gentle pressure. One structured commitment.

metal.heading: The Goat's hidden Wood, 乙
metal.text: Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, a little 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood. For a Metal Day Master that hidden Wood is your wealth element, the things you shape and manage. It points to small, practical gains: a skill that pays off later, a tidy system at home, a project you see through from start to finish. Keep your eye on modest, steady results. They're the ones this Goat rewards.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hidden Wood for Metal: small practical results, steadily.

water.heading: The Goat's hidden Wood, 乙
water.text: Inside the Goat sit three hidden stems: 己 Earth as the main one, a little 丁 Fire, and a sliver of 乙 Wood. For a Water Day Master that hidden Wood is your output element, expression and creativity. In a year when the visible energy presses on you, this is the release valve: writing, music, teaching, a hobby that lets something flow out. Keep one creative outlet running all year, even ten minutes a day.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Hidden Wood is your release valve. Ten creative minutes a day.

spring.heading: Your birth season and the Fire peak
spring.text: Born in spring, you carry Wood's momentum into a Fire year, and Wood feeds Fire. That makes June and July feel fast and productive for you, even exciting. The risk is running on enthusiasm and forgetting to refuel. Plan a lighter week straight after the solstice. Spring-born people usually notice tiredness late, after the energy has already been spent.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Spring-born: rest after midsummer, before you feel tired.

summer.heading: Your birth season and the Fire peak
summer.text: Born in summer, you already have plenty of heat in your chart, and the 丙午 and 丁未 months double it. Expect a peak that's bright and slightly overwhelming: lots of plans, lots of people, short tempers on hot days. Keep cool on purpose. Early mornings, water nearby, fewer evening commitments. You don't need more fire in midsummer. You need shade.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Summer-born: your midsummer needs shade, not more fire.

autumn.heading: Your birth season and the Fire peak
autumn.text: Born in autumn, your chart leans toward Metal's clarity, and Fire melts Metal. The midsummer months may feel pressured: more demands, louder people, less space to think. It's also when you get shaped into something better. Take the challenges one at a time, and keep a short weekly review so the heat refines you instead of rattling you.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Autumn-born: a weekly review turns the heat into refining.

winter.heading: Your birth season and the Fire peak
winter.text: Born in winter, your chart carries cold Water, and a Fire peak is the warmth it rarely gets. Many winter-born people feel unusually good in mid-2027: more social, more confident, more willing to be seen. Use it. Make the call, plan the trip, launch the thing. Just expect water and fire to argue sometimes, and give yourself quiet nights in between.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Winter-born: the Fire peak warms you. Use it to be seen.

earth.heading: Your birth season and the Fire peak
earth.text: Born in the Earth days between seasons, your chart has extra ground, and Fire makes Earth. The midsummer months feed you: more stability, more confidence, a sense that things are piling up in your favor. Watch the piling up. Too much Earth feels heavy and stuck. Move your body, clear clutter and say no to one commitment for every two new ones.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Earth-days born: for every two new commitments, drop one.

strong.heading: How to pace 2027
strong.text: A strong chart can take a lot of this year's heat and still want more. That's your edge and your trap. Pace the year in three acts. February to May: start things. June to September: push the two that are working and drop the rest. October to January: finish, review and rest. The people who struggle in strong-chart years are the ones who start new projects in October because they still have energy. Let autumn be for closing loops.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Three acts: start, push two, finish. Don't start things in October.

weak.heading: How to pace 2027
weak.text: A weak chart in a Fire Goat year should pace like a long walk, not a sprint. Pick one main goal for 2027 and two small ones. Put your effort into the months marked supportive, and use the heavier ones for maintenance: keep the habit, keep the relationships, don't launch anything new. Rest isn't falling behind. For you, it's how the good months happen at all. Whenever a new saju month begins, check your energy and adjust the plan honestly.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: One main goal, two small ones. Rest is how good months happen.

wood.heading: A first look at 2028
wood.text: The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins, the Earth Monkey. For a Wood Day Master, 戊 Earth is wealth, the ground you work and shape, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is power, the structure that trims a tree into shape. So 2028 is likely to feel more practical and more demanding than 2027: less talk, more results, clearer expectations. Use December and January to decide which of this year's ideas deserve real resources next year. Bring two, not ten.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: 2028 is Earth Monkey. Pick two ideas worth real resources.

fire.heading: A first look at 2028
fire.text: The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins, the Earth Monkey. For a Fire Day Master, 戊 Earth is output, the things your warmth produces, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is wealth, what you shape and manage. After a Fire year that gave you company and heat, 2028 asks you to turn that energy into something tangible. Use the last weeks of 2027 to finish one creative project, so you walk into the Monkey year with proof, not only plans.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Finish one creative thing before Ipchun 2028.

earth.heading: A first look at 2028
earth.text: The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins, the Earth Monkey. For an Earth Day Master, 戊 is your own element and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is output. That points to a year of standing on your own ground and expressing it: more independence, more ideas spoken out loud. The Fire Goat year fed you. The Monkey year asks what you'll make of it. Spend January writing down what you learned in 2027, because it becomes next year's material.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Write down what 2027 taught you. It's next year's material.

metal.heading: A first look at 2028
metal.text: The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins, the Earth Monkey. For a Metal Day Master, 戊 Earth is resource, support and learning, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is your own element. After a Fire year that pressed and tested you, 2028 tends to feel like getting your footing back: more backing, more confidence, more people like you around. Close 2027 by thanking whoever helped you through the heat. Those links carry forward.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: After the heat, 2028 gives footing back. Thank your helpers now.

water.heading: A first look at 2028
water.text: The reading ends at Ipchun 2028, when 戊申 begins, the Earth Monkey. For a Water Day Master, 戊 Earth is power, structure and responsibility, and the Monkey's 庚 Metal is resource, the source that refills water. So 2028 pairs bigger expectations with real support. Expect more accountability and more help at the same time. In December, think about which commitments you'd be proud to hold, and say no early to the rest.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: 2028 brings expectations and support together. Choose your commitments.

mood.text: The year begins at Ipchun with 壬寅, Water over Tiger. It's a fresh, ambitious start: big rivers feeding young trees, the kind of month when plans suddenly feel possible. Write down what you want from the Fire Goat year while the energy is clean. Don't overpack the calendar yet; eleven more months are coming, and the best ones aren't always the first.

癸卯, rain over Rabbit, is spring's softest month. Things grow quietly underground before anything shows. It suits gentle starts, small habits, tidying your space and reconnecting with people you've drifted from. Push less, tend more. What you plant softly now tends to last longer than what you force.

甲辰, a tall tree rooted in damp earth, brings ambition and structure together. Projects take root and start to look real. It's a strong month for committing to the plans you sketched in February, signing up, setting dates, telling people. The Dragon branch stores Water too, so feelings run deeper than they look.

乙巳, a flowering vine in early summer heat, is social and charming. People reach out, ideas spread, invitations multiply, and the days feel long and bright. Enjoy it. Keep an eye on how many things you promise, because the Snake branch notices who follows through and who only says yes.

丙午, Sun over Horse, is the hottest month of a Fire year, Fire stacked on Fire. Energy runs high and so do tempers. It's a month for big visible moves, celebrations, travel and bold conversations, and also the month most likely to burn people out. Cool evenings, water and early nights help more than any productivity trick.

丁未 repeats the year's own pillar: candle Fire over Goat Earth. Whatever 2027 is about for you, it's loudest now. Take a moment mid-year to notice what the Fire Goat has been teaching you, what's working, what isn't, what you'd quietly like to stop. Decide what to keep for the second half.

戊申, mountain over Monkey, brings the first breath of Metal after a long hot stretch. Heat starts turning into results. It's a practical, getting-things-done month: organize, finish, decide, file. The Monkey branch is clever and restless, so expect useful shortcuts and a few distractions.

己酉, garden earth over Rooster, is harvest season in full. Precision, refinement and appreciation. It's a good month for editing your work, reviewing your plans, fixing details and noticing what has quietly gone well this year. The Rooster likes things tidy; your environment will affect your mood more than usual.

庚戌, sword over Dog, is crisp and decisive. Cut what isn't working: a habit, a commitment, a project that's run its course. Endings now make room for what comes next, and the Dog branch keeps loyalty strong for what you choose to keep. Say no clearly and kindly.

辛亥, jewel over Pig, cools everything down. Water returns after months of Fire and Earth. It's a month for reflection, rest, quiet beauty and generous company. Slow down before the year's final stretch, and let yourself enjoy small luxuries without guilt.

壬子, Water over Rat, is deep winter. The year's Fire is fully cooled and the mood turns inward. Inner work, honest planning for 2028 and close company suit this month best. Big public pushes feel heavier now; quiet preparation feels natural.

癸丑, rain over Ox, closes the Fire Goat year in January 2028. Quiet, patient and preparatory, like a field waiting under frost. Tie up loose ends, rest properly, and let the year end without forcing a dramatic finale. The next Ipchun is only weeks away.

god_a.text: Your own stem meets you this month: it's your Friend (比肩), same element, same polarity. Self-reliance and peers dominate. You'll feel confident in your own way of doing things and drawn to people who think like you. It's ideal for independent work, solo projects and honest conversations between equals. The trap is stubbornness: two people with the same instinct can dig in on opposite sides of a small issue. Let someone else win one.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Friend month: your own energy doubled. Go independent.

god_a.text: Peers and rivals light up this month, because its stem is your Rob Wealth (劫財), your element in the opposite polarity. Expect lively people, competition and collaboration in equal measure. Teams can achieve a lot now; rivalries can waste just as much energy. Choose the team. Be careful with shared plans and impulsive promises, and keep agreements about time and effort clear.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Rob Wealth month: rivals or teammates. Choose teammates.

god_a.text: Pleasure and creativity lead. The month's stem, your Eating God (食神), is saju's gentlest output energy: good food, generous moods, making things for the joy of it. It's a lovely month to host, cook, learn an art, share a skill or simply enjoy life without justifying it. Your ideas flow easily. Let yourself play; productivity can wait a few days.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Eating God month: make things, eat well, play.

god_a.text: Expect sharp ideas and sharp words: your Hurting Officer (傷官) sits in the stem, the bold side of expression. Creative breakthroughs, honest feedback and rule-breaking come easily. Diplomacy doesn't. It's a great month to pitch, write, perform or redesign something that annoys you, and a risky one for sending the strongly worded message. Draft it, sleep, then decide.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Hurting Officer month: brilliant and blunt. Draft, wait, send.

god_a.text: Doors open through people now, thanks to your Indirect Wealth (偏財) in the stem: opportunities, spontaneity, wider social reach. Say yes to the coffee, the event, the introduction. Try something you've never done. Not every door leads somewhere, so pick the ones that genuinely interest you, and follow up properly with the people you meet.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Indirect Wealth month: doors open through people. Walk through one.

god_a.text: Steady effort pays off with your Direct Wealth (正財) on top: practical results, careful management, the satisfaction of things working. It's a good month for organizing your life, finishing projects, building routines and taking care of what you already have. Less exciting than an adventure month, and often more satisfying by the end of it.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Direct Wealth month: steady effort, solid results.

god_a.text: Pressure arrives with this month's stem, your Seven Killings (七殺), the strongest challenge energy in saju. Demanding people, high stakes, tests of nerve. It can bring out real courage and show you how resilient you are. It can also exhaust you if you fight every battle. Pick the one that matters, protect your sleep, and let the rest wait.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Seven Killings month: pressure. Pick your battles.

god_a.text: Structure and recognition come through this month's stem, your Direct Officer (正官). Responsibility, commitments, being taken seriously. It's a good month to accept a role, make a formal promise, show your reliability or clarify rules at home or work. Rules may feel heavier than usual; keep the useful ones and quietly question the rest.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Direct Officer month: commit and be reliable.

god_a.text: Intuition takes the lead, with your Indirect Resource (偏印) on top: unusual ideas, solitary learning, sudden insights. It's ideal for research, reflection, journaling and following a strange curiosity wherever it goes. You may want more time alone than usual. Take it, and still check in with the people who'd worry if you vanished.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Indirect Resource month: follow curiosity. Check in with friends.

god_a.text: Support flows toward you under your Direct Resource (正印): mentors, learning, comfort, protection. Ask for help, sign up for the course, accept the offer of a meal or a lift. People are more willing to back you than you think. It's also a good month to rest deeply and let yourself be looked after.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Direct Resource month: ask for help. It's there.

god_b.text: Closing the year, your Friend energy returns, the same stem as your Day Master. Spend these weeks with the people who feel like your own kind, and reflect honestly on what you did your own way in 2027. Notice where independence served you and where it kept help away.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Friend month: your people, honest reflection.

god_b.text: At the year's end, Rob Wealth comes back: peers and shared plans. Settle any open agreements with friends or partners before the new year, return what you borrowed, and celebrate with the people who helped you through the Fire months.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end Rob Wealth: settle shared plans, thank helpers.

god_b.text: Winter brings back your Eating God: comfort, creativity and enjoyment. End the year with something you make purely for pleasure, a long meal with people you love, and permission to do nothing useful for a whole afternoon.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Eating God: a good meal, something made for joy.

god_b.text: Sharp insight returns as the year closes: Hurting Officer energy again. Use it for an honest private review of 2027. Turn criticism into resolutions instead of complaints, and write down one thing you'll do differently after Ipchun.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end Hurting Officer: honest review, private and kind.

god_b.text: New connections show up near the year's end, because Indirect Wealth returns. Note the ideas and people that appear now; some of them will matter in 2028. No need to act yet, just notice and keep in touch.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Indirect Wealth: note the new connections.

god_b.text: Practical order is the theme as the year winds down: Direct Wealth again. Tidy your files, your home and your promises so the new year starts clean. A boring weekend of sorting now buys you a lighter spring.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Direct Wealth: tidy everything before Ipchun.

god_b.text: Pressure appears at the finish line, as Seven Killings returns. Don't take on anything new in these weeks. Finish what's open, rest, and let the year end without a final heroic push nobody asked for.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end Seven Killings: finish, don't start.

god_b.text: Responsibility returns for the closing weeks with Direct Officer energy. Wrap up commitments properly, hand things over cleanly, and give yourself credit for everything you carried through the year.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Direct Officer: wrap up commitments with pride.

god_b.text: Reflection deepens as the year closes, with Indirect Resource energy back. Journal, read, take long walks, and let your intuition sketch next year's direction before your logical mind gets involved.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Year-end Indirect Resource: journal next year's direction.

god_b.text: Rest and support come back for the year's last weeks, with Direct Resource energy. Accept help, sleep deeply, and let people look after you before the next cycle begins at Ipchun.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Year-end Direct Resource: rest and let people care for you.

clash.text: This month's branch also clashes with your day branch, the animal under your Day Master. Expect movement in personal life: plans change, routines get shaken, someone close needs attention. Stay flexible, keep the essentials steady, and don't make permanent decisions in a hurry.

combo.text: Its branch combines with your day branch too, a harmonious link. Personal life feels easier: people cooperate, home is calm, conversations land well.
Your day branch finds a partner in this month's branch as well, so relationships and home feel supported. Good timing for shared plans and invitations.
Once more this year, the month's branch harmonizes with your day branch. Use the ease for something you'd normally find hard to ask for.

best: Bom's note: on paper this is one of your two smoothest months, because its elements support what your chart needs most. A good window for important moves.
This is your other smooth month of the year. If you postponed something earlier, consider bringing it back now.
hard: Yeon's note: this is one of the two months whose elements work against your chart's balance. Plan lighter, rest more, and don't judge the whole year by it.
Here's the second of your harder months. Keep commitments modest and lean on the habits that steady you.

gap-wood.the-year:
For Gap Wood, the Fire Goat year has two faces. The heavenly stem 丁 is your Hurting Officer (傷官): Fire that your Wood produces, in the opposite polarity. It's the energy of expression, talent and speaking your mind. Expect a year where you say what you think more often, push back on rules that don't make sense, and want your work to carry your own signature.

The branch 未 holds 己 Earth, your Direct Wealth (正財): steady effort, practical results, the things you build and take care of. So 2027 pairs a restless voice with a practical goal. At your best, you turn sharp opinions into concrete improvements: a better process, a bolder project, a clearer boundary.

The watch-out is tact. Hurting Officer years can make a pine sound like an axe. Say the true thing once, kindly, and then put your energy into building the alternative. People follow builders more readily than critics.
gap-wood.the-plan: Your plan for the Fire Goat year, Gap Wood: pick one thing you've been complaining about and fix it with your own hands, in work, at home or in a friendship. Let your expressive streak show in something you make, a talk, a portfolio, a project with your name on it. And keep your roots watered: sleep, trees, people who don't need you to lead them. A year of output asks for a year of refilling.

gap-wood.speaker: bom
gap-wood.text: Fire Goat for the tall pine: your voice gets louder this year.

gap-wood.speaker: yeon
gap-wood.text: Hurting Officer year. Say it once, kindly. Then build.

gap-wood.speaker: bom
gap-wood.text: Practical goals give your sharp opinions somewhere to go.

gap-wood.speaker: yeon
gap-wood.text: Critics get ignored. Builders get followed. Be the builder.

gap-wood.speaker: bom
gap-wood.text: Fix one thing you complain about, with your own hands.

gap-wood.speaker: yeon
gap-wood.text: Lots of output this year. Refill on purpose.

spring.intro:
You're Wood born in spring, a young tree in a forest that is all growing at once. Element match: your birth season carries your own element, so you walk into 2027 with a strong, familiar sense of yourself. A Fire year will either feed that confidence or test it, depending on whether Fire helps your element, and the months below show where. Your default style holds up well under pressure; your challenge is adapting when a month asks for something different.

For Gap Wood heading into 2027, this birth season shapes how you take a Fire year: as fuel for expression, or as heat you need to manage.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Strong default style. Some months will ask you to flex.

summer.intro:
Wood born in summer is a tree in full leaf under a hot sky, green and generous and a little thirsty. You pour into the season: your birth season pulls your element outward, so you meet 2027 as a doer: you want to make, say and show things. A Fire year amplifies expression for some charts and drains it for others. Pace your output across the twelve months instead of front-loading it into spring.

For Gap Wood heading into 2027, this birth season shapes how you take a Fire year: as fuel for expression, or as heat you need to manage.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: Pace your output across twelve months, not three.

earth.intro:
Your Wood arrived in the Earth days that close a season: a tree with its roots wrapped around heavy soil. You shape the season: your element works on your birth season, so you approach 2027 like a project manager: goals, timelines, results. That's useful in a structured year. Leave space for rest and reflection too; some months are built for that.

For Gap Wood heading into 2027, this birth season shapes how you take a Fire year: as fuel for expression, or as heat you need to manage.

panel.speaker: yeon
panel.text: Project manager energy. Schedule the rest months too.

autumn.intro:
Picture Wood born in autumn: a tree in the season of the axe, when the air turns sharp and the leaves come down. The season tests you: your birth season presses on your element, so you're used to pressure and handle demanding months well. In 2027, notice the months that ease off and actually take them. Discipline is a strength; rest is part of discipline.

For Gap Wood heading into 2027, this birth season shapes how you take a Fire year: as fuel for expression, or as heat you need to manage.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You handle pressure well. Take the easy months seriously too.

winter.intro:
Wood born in winter is a bare tree with its roots deep in cold, wet ground, quietly drinking. The season feeds you: your birth season feeds your element, so you carry a reserve into 2027, like starting a long walk with a full water bottle. That reserve helps in the demanding months of a Fire year. Use the easy months to refill it rather than spending everything early.

For Gap Wood heading into 2027, this birth season shapes how you take a Fire year: as fuel for expression, or as heat you need to manage.

panel.speaker: bom
panel.text: You start the year with a full bottle. Refill in the easy months.

gap-wood.strong:
Your chart is strong, which matters for a year like this: you can handle intense months, stay steady through change, and push hard when a month supports it. The blind spot is ignoring the months that ask you to slow down. Strong charts treat every month like a sprint. In 2027, treat the hard months as maintenance months: fewer launches, more care, cleaner foundations.

Gap Wood with this much support can handle a loud, expressive year. Aim the voice at something you're building.
gap-wood.weak:
Your chart is the weak kind, which in a year plan means pacing matters more than for most. Supportive months will feel noticeably easier, demanding months noticeably heavier. That's information, not a verdict. In 2027, front-load your important moves into the months marked smooth, and give yourself permission to coast through the hard ones.

Gap Wood on a lighter chart may find this Fire year draining. Choose fewer battles and more rest.
